step1_analysis.description: A clocked differential preamplifier used in the flash ADC of the receiver. It precharges the output nodes to VDD when the clock is low, and integrates the differential input voltage onto the output nodes when the clock is high, providing voltage gain before a subsequent regenerative latch stage.

paper_reference.title: A Serial-Link Transceiver Based on 8-GSamples/s A/D and D/A Converters in 0.25-m CMOS

voltage_gain.description: Differential voltage gain at the end of the evaluation phase.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm * t_int / C_load. With I_tail=100uA, gm~1mA/V, t_int=300ps, C_load=20fF, Gain ~ 15 V/V = 23 dB. With higher parasitics or shorter integration, expect ~10-15 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the integration time and load capacitance. Adjusted for Sky130 1.8V process.

evaluation_delay.description: Time from clock rising edge to the output dropping by 0.3V (to 1.5V).

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on tail current discharging the load capacitance.

precharge_time.description: Time required to precharge the outputs back to VDD after the clock falls.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Limited by the PMOS pull-up strength and load capacitance.

average_power.description: Average power consumption at 1 GHz clock frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: Static power (100uA * 50% duty cycle) + Dynamic power (2 * 20fF * 1V * 1GHz) = 50uA + 40uA = 90uA. Power = 1.8V * 90uA = 162uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on 1GHz operation and estimated tail current.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure voltage gain, evaluation delay, precharge time, and average power of the dynamic preamplifier.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Dynamic Preamplifier Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VBIAS BIAS 0 0.7
VVREF VREF 0 0.9
VINP INP 0 0.95
VCLK CLK 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0.1n 20p 20p 0.4n 1n)
VCLKB CLK_B 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0.1n 20p 20p 0.4n 1n)

C1 OUTP 0 20f
C2 OUTM 0 20f

XM5 OUTP CLK_B VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 OUTM CLK_B VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM3 TAIL CLK N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 BIAS GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM1 TAIL CLK VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 OUTP OUTM CLK_B VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM7 OUTP VREF TAIL GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 OUTM INP TAIL GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

.control
tran 1p 3n

* Measure evaluation delay (time for OUTM to drop to 1.5V)
meas tran delay_eval trig v(clk) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(outm) val=1.5 fall=1

* Measure voltages at 0.4ns (300ps after CLK rises)
meas tran v_outm_eval find v(outm) at=0.4n
meas tran v_outp_eval find v(outp) at=0.4n

* Calculate gain
let vdiff_out = v_outp_eval - v_outm_eval
let gain = vdiff_out / 0.05
let gain_db = 20 * log10(abs(gain))
print gain gain_db

* Measure precharge time
meas tran t_precharge trig v(clk) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(outm) val=1.7 rise=1

* Measure average power
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
meas tran avg_power avg power from=0 to=2n
print avg_power

quit
.endc
.end
